newsitem.title: USA: Corn growers see US 97/98 acreage at 81 mln acres.
newsitem.headline: Corn growers see US 97/98 acreage at 81 mln acres.

text.p: Tampa, Fla., Feb 27, Reuter - The head of the National Corn Growers Association Thursday forecast 1997/98 U.S. corn acreage at 81.0 million acres, in line with projections by the U.S. Agriculture Department.

"I think the increase in soybean prices we've seen over the past month are definitely going to take some heat off the corn acreage this year," Wallie Hardie, president of the corn grower group, told a news conference at the start of a convention of soybean and corn growers.
"My guess is that we're going to come in at an 81-million-acre area," he said.
